result_type.title: Row type
result_type.description: Which kind of row this is: a directory listing, a full company profile, a client review, or an error for one input.

name.title: Company name
name.description: Company name as listed on Clutch.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Stable Clutch identifier for the company, taken from its profile URL.

profile_url.title: Profile URL
profile_url.description: Direct link to the company's Clutch profile.

source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: The directory page or input URL this row came from.

website.title: Website
website.description: The company's own website, with Clutch referral tracking parameters removed.

description.title: Description
description.description: Company description as published on Clutch.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Average client review rating out of 5.

review_count.title: Review count
review_count.description: Total number of verified client reviews on the profile.

is_verified.title: Verified
is_verified.description: Whether Clutch shows a verification badge for this company.

verification.title: Verification badges
verification.description: Verification badges shown on the profile, such as Verified or Premier Verified.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location shown on a directory listing.

headquarters.title: Headquarters
headquarters.description: Headquarters location from the company profile.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Every office location, each flagged for whether it is the headquarters.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Contact phone number, available when raw HTML is requested.

address.title: Postal address
address.description: Full postal address, available when raw HTML is requested.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Number of Clutch members who joined the company's network.

service_lines.title: Service lines
service_lines.description: Services offered, each with the percentage of work it represents.

focus_areas.title: Focus areas
focus_areas.description: Technology and specialism breakdowns, grouped by discipline, each with percentages.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Industries served, each with the percentage of work it represents.

clients.title: Client sizes
clients.description: Client size distribution across small business, midmarket, and enterprise.

cost_rating.title: Cost rating
cost_rating.description: Average client rating for cost, out of 5.

most_common_project_size.title: Most common project size
most_common_project_size.description: The project size band most often reported by reviewers.

most_common_project_size_reviews.title: Reviews behind project size
most_common_project_size_reviews.description: How many reviews the most common project size is based on.

pricing_by_service.title: Pricing by service
pricing_by_service.description: Typical project size per service line, with the number of reviews behind each figure.

packages.title: Packages
example: Search Engine Optimization Packages — starting at $3,500/month

review_rating_overall.title: Overall review rating
review_rating_overall.description: Overall review rating from the profile's review insights block.

review_ratings.title: Rating breakdown
review_ratings.description: Average sub-ratings for quality, schedule, cost, and willingness to refer.

top_mentions.title: Top mentions
top_mentions.description: Themes reviewers mention most, with how often each appears.

has_reviews.title: Has reviews
has_reviews.description: Whether any client reviews were found on the profile.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Clutch's own LLM-ready markdown rendering of the page. Ideal for RAG pipelines and AI agents.

html.title: Raw HTML
html.description: Raw page source, returned only when the HTML output format is selected.

is_featured.title: Featured review
is_featured.description: Whether Clutch marks this review as the featured review.

review_date.title: Review date
review_date.description: Date the review was published, as shown on Clutch.

ratings.title: Review sub-ratings
ratings.description: This reviewer's sub-ratings for quality, schedule, cost, and willingness to refer.

project_services.title: Project services
project_services.description: Services delivered in the reviewed project.

project_size.title: Project size
project_size.description: Budget band for the reviewed project.

project_summary.title: Project summary
project_summary.description: What the company was hired to do.
project_summary.example: Hired to build a new CMS using Next.js and rebuild a customer-facing website.

feedback_summary.title: Feedback summary
feedback_summary.description: Clutch's summary of the client's feedback.
feedback_summary.example: The team has been very communicative and responsive weekly via Slack.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviewer's role and company, as published.

reviewer_client_size.title: Reviewer company size
reviewer_client_size.description: Employee band of the reviewing company.

reviewer_review_type.title: Review type
reviewer_review_type.description: How the review was collected, for example an online review or a phone interview.

reviewer_is_verified.title: Reviewer verified
reviewer_is_verified.description: Whether Clutch verified this reviewer's identity.

company_name.title: Reviewed company
company_name.description: Name of the company this review belongs to.

company_slug.title: Reviewed company slug
company_slug.description: Clutch slug of the company this review belongs to.

fetched_at.title: Fetched at
fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this row was collected.

error_message.title: Error message
error_message.description: Plain-language description of what went wrong for one input.
error_message.example: that page was not found on the site
